description: This file defines a custom report class for generating weekly timesheet XML reports for employees based on attendance data, including date calculations, database queries, and XML formatting.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml to generate weekly attendance timesheet XML reports.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of employee attendance over weeks, calculating work hours and formatting data into XML.
